outline.chapter_title: Introduction to the Memory Challenge in LLM Finetuning
outline.description: This chapter establishes the motivation for QLoRA by discussing the computational hurdles of fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) and the necessity of memory-efficient techniques.
subtopics: The Role of Finetuning in LLMs: Specialization and Alignment
The 'Memory Wall': Calculating GPU Memory Requirements for 16-bit Finetuning
Introduction to Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT)
The Trade-off Between Model Scale and Precision

outline.chapter_title: Foundations of Quantization and Low-Rank Adaptation
outline.description: Before diving into QLoRA, this chapter provides the necessary theoretical background on standard quantization methods and the mechanics of LoRA.
subtopics: Basics of Quantization: From FP32 to Int8
The Outlier Problem and Block-wise Quantization
Dequantization and Quantization Constants
Low-Rank Adapters (LoRA) Theory: Factorized Projections
Analyzing Memory Footprints: Model Weights vs. Activation Gradients

outline.description: This chapter explains the first major innovation of QLoRA: a new data type specifically designed for the distribution of neural network weights.
subtopics: Quantile Quantization: Information-Theoretic Optimality
The Normality Assumption of Pretrained Weights
Constructing the NF4 Data Type: Symmetrical and Asymmetrical Quantiles
The Role of the Zero-point in NF4
Empirical Comparison: NF4 vs. FP4 and Int4

outline.chapter_title: Advanced Memory Savings: Double Quantization and Paged Optimizers
outline.description: This chapter explores how QLoRA further reduces the memory footprint through secondary quantization and innovative memory management.
subtopics: The Overhead of Quantization Constants
Double Quantization (DQ) Mechanism: Quantizing the Quantizers
Memory Spikes and Gradient Checkpointing
Paged Optimizers: Leveraging NVIDIA Unified Memory
Calculating Total Memory Savings from DQ and Paging

outline.description: This chapter synthesizes the previous concepts into a cohesive architectural workflow, explaining how a model is stored, computed, and updated.
subtopics: The QLoRA Equation: Combining NF4 and BF16 LoRA
Storage vs. Computation Data Types
The Forward Pass: Dequantization on the Fly
The Backward Pass: Propagating Gradients through Frozen Quantized Weights
Hyperparameter Tuning: The Importance of Adapter Placement across Layers

outline.chapter_title: Evaluating QLoRA: Performance and the Guanaco Models
outline.description: This chapter examines the experimental results of QLoRA, focusing on its ability to match 16-bit performance and the creation of the Guanaco model family.
subtopics: Benchmarking QLoRA against Full 16-bit Finetuning
Recovery of Precision: Can Adapters Offset Quantization Loss?
The Guanaco Model Family: Training on OASST1
Analysis of Instruction Tuning: Data Quality vs. Dataset Size
Orthogonality of Benchmarks: MMLU vs. Chatbot Performance

outline.chapter_title: Measuring Chatbot Quality: From GPT-4 to Elo Ratings
outline.description: This chapter discusses the methodology for evaluating generative AI, contrasting automated model-based evaluation with human judgment.
subtopics: The Limitations of Multiple-Choice Benchmarks (MMLU)
Automated Evaluation via GPT-4: Prompting and Scoring
Human Evaluation Protocols and the Role of Amazon Mechanical Turk
The Elo Rating System: Tournament-style Model Comparison
Analyzing Correlation and Bias in Model-based Evaluation

outline.description: The final chapter moves beyond statistics to analyze the actual behavior of QLoRA-tuned models, identifying specific strengths and failure modes.
subtopics: Factual Recall and the Confidence-Accuracy Gap
Suggestibility and Instruction Following: 'Secret Keeping' Tests
Mathematical Reasoning and the Need for Step-by-Step Decomposition
Theory of Mind: Capabilities and Failures in Social Inference
Future Directions: 3-bit Quantization and Other PEFT Methods
